transcript: Three things I will not do in order to protect my brain. These are simple, but they shape the entire destiny of your mind. Number one, I will not touch my phone the moment I wake up. When the eyes open, the brain shifts from theta to alpha, a sacred transition where the subconscious is open, soft, and easily programmed. If the first thing you feed your mind is noise, chaos, notifications, you damage your dopamine for the entire day. Your mind becomes restless, your fingers crave the screen, and you lose your inner stillness before the day even begins. Number two, I will not speak to myself with negativity. The words you whisper to yourself are not harmless. They are instructions to the brain. Speak enough fear, and the brain wires for fear. Speak weakness, and it builds pathways for weakness. But speak strength, clarity, healing, and the mind reshapes itself around those truths, you become what you repeatedly tell your brain. Number three, I will not consume highly processed foods. In the old teachings we say, a muddy river cannot show you your reflection, and the same is true for the mind. Processed foods inflame the brain, age it faster, cloud your thinking, and dim the light of your spirit. Feed the brain clean. Living foods and clarity returns like sunlight through morning fog. Protect your brain, and your entire life becomes lighter, calmer, and sharper.
